description: Per-Brain automatic discovery: connectors (allowlisted public sources), pre-declared validation thresholds, follow-up iterations and declared research inputs. Thresholds are fixed BEFORE any download (pre-registration); changing one is a reviewed code change. Avenues are tried in order, each at most once (identical parameters never repeat), for gaps that are still actionable in the persistent gap ledger.

water-temp.purpose: independent continuous-sensor (out-of-sample) validation of production M0; Level-4 protected-truth status (metadata only)

inputs.limitation: fleet forcing missing: fleet coordinates unavailable

weaknesses.title: Production M0 has a systematic seasonal bias in the fleet validation (spring MAM about -1.05 C cold, autumn SON about +0.74 C warm) that nothing corrects; every temperature-gated bowfishing rule inherits it
weaknesses.nextEvidence: continuous lake-surface (<=1.5 m) temperature loggers at 6+ reservoirs outside the M0 calibration set (see the owner-action record)

weaknesses.title: The published water-temperature uncertainty is one fixed band although the model error is seasonal and asymmetric (spring cold, autumn warm), so the band is wrong in some seasons
weaknesses.nextEvidence: more independent lake-surface temperature loggers to confirm interval calibration

actions.publisher: reservoir operators (TVA, US Army Corps of Engineers districts) and state agencies running lake-surface loggers
actions.dataset: continuous lake-surface (depth <= 1.5 m) water temperature, 2023-present, at 6+ reservoirs that are not in the M0 calibration set (today only 4 independent lakes exist; USGS 'Temp-Water' series on CWMS are mostly outflow/river gauges and were deliberately not used)
actions.access: request from the operator or agency; the lake-surface depth and location of each series must be confirmed before use; public availability NOT verified
actions.addresses: decide whether a seasonal/region correction of M0 helps lakes in general (the fleet-wide correction improved the fleet holdout by 0.21 C but made one already-good lake worse)

scoreMeta.movable: no: the only blocker is the Level-4 protected-truth sufficiency gate (frozen); a lower RMSE cannot move a gate-based score

lake-brain.purpose: independent daily lake-level source (USGS) per fleet lake: redundancy for primary-source (CWMS) fetch failures

weaknesses.title: Fleet lakes without a fresh independent daily level source depend on one primary feed and go stale or abstain when it fails
weaknesses.nextEvidence: an operator level feed for each fleet lake without an independent source (see the owner-action records)

scoreMeta.movable: no: capped at 3.0 while the profiled share is under 10% (uncapped candidate 6.3 shows as 3.0); dimension values are typed in the builder

water-clarity.purpose: new Secchi observations for the next clarity re-certification

inputs.limitation: private clarity-candidate root (stage_r31/cache) is external private data: the R3.1 re-certification re-run cannot be reconstructed from public sources in this campaign

queries: Secchi depth reservoir remote sensing validation
water clarity reservoir turbidity rainfall decay

actions.dataset: the stage_r31 cache of the private clarity-candidate root (SECTOR_CLARITY_PRIVATE_ROOT)
actions.access: restore the cache from the owner's private research backup and set SECTOR_CLARITY_PRIVATE_ROOT; deliberately not copied into the research home to avoid duplicates
actions.addresses: re-run of the R3.1 certification so the candidate can be re-checked against the new Secchi observations

scoreMeta.movable: no: recorded from the candidate file; production clarity is unscored

biological-state.purpose: national field-observation season profiles for the bowfishing species (aggregate only: no per-lake presence)

tests.claim: freshwater drum feed actively at night
bowfin move shallow and feed at night in warm months
spotted gar are more active at night (outside spring)
silver carp catch rates rise at night near shore
smallmouth buffalo night catch far above day at <3 m (draft: >10x)
common carp are less active at night
common carp show no consistent night advantage in navigation pools
bowfin activity falls below about 10 C
spotted gar movement falls below about 10 C
longnose gar activity is lowest in cold water
common carp do not avoid 26-30 C water
silver carp stay active in cold water

scoreMeta.movable: by species/knowledge counts, not by field validation (FISH-VAL-001 open)

wind.purpose: peer-reviewed leads for the open wind gaps

inputs.limitation: stage3a evidence cache (rows.pkl) lives in the private iOS research repo: certification re-score cannot be regenerated here

actions.dataset: paired shore-vs-model wind observations: 24 site-nights (WIND-VAL-001) and 36 surface-class observations (WIND-VAL-002) at real banks
actions.access: collect with a handheld or logging anemometer at pilot-lake banks (the counts are the requirement stated in brains/wind/research/GAPS.json)
actions.addresses: exposure ordering and surface-class validation (0 of 24 / 0 of 36 today)

actions.publisher: Sector field collection or the reservoir operator's meteorological station
actions.dataset: an over-water wind reference at or near the pilot lake (certification cap 7.0 lifts only with one)
actions.access: deploy a lake-surface anemometer, or request meteorological-station data from the operator; existence of a public over-water series for the pilot lake NOT verified

scoreMeta.movable: only by changing the committed evidence the rubric reads
scoreMeta.baselineNote: Wind Capability v2 adopted value (a different measurement from the 3.3 certification score)

weaknesses.title: The Wind Brain has no seasonal prior for how often a night is calm enough to fish at a lake, so a bowfisher cannot plan beyond the forecast horizon
weaknesses.evidence: brains/wind/research/GAPS.json (WIND-CNF-001 strong-wind nights are not forecast)
weaknesses.nextEvidence: hourly airport observations from stations near each reservoir (IEM archive); lake-surface anemometers for over-water wind

vegetation.purpose: peer-reviewed leads for the open vegetation gaps

queries: aquatic plant survey Tennessee River reservoir

actions.publisher: state fisheries/conservation agency and reservoir operator aquatic-plant programs

actions.access: request from the agency or operator; existence of a public survey series for the pilot lake NOT verified

sector-intelligence.purpose: integrate the specialists' validated candidates (never invent them)

weaknesses.title: Specialist outputs are assembled without any tested cross-Brain relationship, so Intelligence adds no validated synthesis
weaknesses.nextEvidence: an independently validated candidate change from a specialist Brain (for example a Water Temp correction that survives validation on 6+ independent lakes) to test against a consumer Brain

budget.note: wall-clock research window (8 h default; `init --budget-hours`), avenues per Brain, consecutive no-progress avenues before STALLED, downloaded bytes per Brain. Research stops when nothing actionable and affordable remains - never to use up the window.
